findings.claim: Concurrent reservations can both succeed against the same stock, allowing the service to accept more reservations than inventory can fulfill.
evidence: evals/cases/case_04/src/inventory.py:9-15 reads the available quantity, sleeps, and then writes a value derived from the stale read without any lock or atomic compare-and-update.

A direct ThreadPoolExecutor probe started two reserve('sku-1', 1) calls against one available unit; in each of five attempts both calls returned true while available('sku-1') ended at 0, proving that two units were promised from one unit of stock.
evals/cases/case_04/tests/test_inventory.py:4-8 exercises only a single reservation and therefore does not detect this concurrent oversell behavior.
